categories.title: Base pack
categories.blurb: Not up for vote. These make the game run better and easier, and most of them are invisible in play.

categories.title: Factories & power
categories.blurb: The industrial core. Create is the mechanical one (cogs, belts, steam), the others add electricity, cables and big machines.

categories.title: Mining & drilling
categories.blurb: Ways to dig out ore without spending every evening with a pickaxe. Create, Mekanism and Immersive Engineering each bring their own drill or miner too.

categories.title: Guns & combat
categories.blurb: Two solid choices. Vote for the one you'd rather have, not both.

categories.title: Quality of life & world
categories.blurb: Small additions that make a friends server nicer. All light.

categories.title: Building and decoration
categories.blurb: Extra blocks for making your base look good. No machines, no new mobs, nothing that changes how the game plays.

categories.title: Bosses & trials
categories.blurb: Not up for vote. Big fights in dungeons out in the world, and wave fights you open yourself. Bosses drop their own gear; seasons count who beat what.

categories.title: On the server only
categories.blurb: Runs on the server, nothing to install on your PC.

mods.howTo: Press **'** (apostrophe, next to Enter), **create a party** and invite friends by their Minecraft name; party members show on each other's maps at any distance. To claim your base, open the world map (**M**), right-click a chunk and choose **Claim**: then only your party can build, break and open chests there.

mods.name: Corpse

mods.howTo:
When you die, your things stay in your body where you fell. It never disappears. For 30 minutes only you can open it; after that your friends can too, so they can bring your things back if you're offline. Your minimap marks where you died.

Right-click the body to open it. The 30 minutes only run while someone is near it. Press **U** for your death history.

mods.name: Create
mods.description: Cogs, belts, steam engines, trains, mechanical drills and presses. The heart of the pack.

videos.title: MINECRAFT CREATE MOD, FOR DUMMIES | lesson 1
3 Early Game Create Mod Farms You NEED in your World
Why Create is the Best Minecraft Mod Ever Made

mods.howTo:
Start with a **water wheel** next to flowing water and a **shaft**: anything on the shaft turns. Make **andesite alloy** (andesite + iron nugget) for shafts, cogwheels and the **mechanical press**. Next: a press over a belt for automatic plates, a millstone for flour and dyes.

In JEI, hold **W** over any Create block to watch its Ponder animation; the **Engineer's Goggles** show speed and stress when you look at a machine.

keys.does: Ponder: hold over a block in JEI

mods.name: Create: Crafts & Additions

mods.howTo: Turns Create's rotation into electricity. Put an **alternator** on a spinning shaft, run **copper wire** (spools) from its connector to a machine's connector, and it has power. **Electric motors** turn power back into rotation; **accumulators** store it.

mods.name: VeinMiner
mods.description: Mine one ore and the whole vein comes out, no key to hold. Works alongside FallingTree: VeinMiner is ore, FallingTree is trees.

mods.howTo: Just mine: break one ore block with the right pickaxe and the rest of the vein (up to 100 blocks) comes out with it. No key to hold. It costs hunger and tool durability, so bring food and a spare pickaxe. Trees are FallingTree's job.

mods.howTo: Craft a **backpack** (leather and a chest) as soon as you can. Wear it in the chest slot and press **B** to open it, or hold it and right-click. Upgrade it later (iron, gold, diamond, netherite) and put upgrades in its side slots: **Pickup** collects items for you, **Magnet** pulls them in, **Crafting** gives a crafting grid inside.

L_Ender's Cataclysm mod | All Bosses
Full Showcase of L_Enders Cataclysm Mod

mods.howTo: Big dungeons generate in the world: a ruined citadel, a sunken city, a burning arena and more, each guarded by a boss. Most are fights for a **group**: go together and bring food, armour and a bed nearby. What they drop is gear you can't get any other way.

mods.name: Mowzie's Mobs
mods.description: Four smaller bosses and some odd creatures met while exploring. Good for two or three players.

videos.title: Minecraft Mowzie's Mobs All Bosses Mod Showcase
Mowzie's Mobs mod | All Bosses
The Mod That Makes Minecraft Bosses ACTUALLY HARD

mods.howTo: You'll meet these while exploring: a frost beast in snowy plains, a sun chief in savanna villages, an armoured knight in a hidden hall underground. Each fight has a pattern: watch it once before you swing. Their drops are unusual tools and weapons.

mods.name: Gateways to Eternity
mods.description: Trials as wave fights: open a gateway, beat the waves, take the reward.

videos.title: Gateways Of Eternity Mod! Get Loot from Portals!
Gateways to Eternity Mod Tutorial

mods.howTo: A gateway is an item: use it on open ground and a portal opens that sends **waves** of monsters at you. Beat every wave before the timer runs out and it pays out its reward. Walk too far away and it fails. Season trials come as gateways.
